title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of One Hundred Fifty Thousand Pesos to Help Defray the Expenses of the Training, Preparation and Participation of a Filipino Athletic Delegation to the Third Asian Games to be Held in Tokyo, Japan, from May Twenty-Four, Nineteen Hundred Fifty-Eight to June First, Nineteen Hundred Fifty-Eight
title.orig: An Act Appropriating the Sum of One Hundred Fifty Thousand Pesos to Help Defray the Expenses of the Training, Preparation and Participation of a Filipino Athletic Delegation to the Third Asian Games to be Held in Tokyo, Japan, from May Twenty-Four, Nineteen Hundred Fifty-Eight to June First, Nineteen Hundred Fifty-Eight

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1958/ra_2050_1958.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sum of one hundred fifty thousand pesos is appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, as an aid to the Philippine Amateur Athletic Federation to defray the expenses of the selection, assembling, equipping, preparation and sending of a competent athletic delegation to represent the Philippines at the Third Asian Games to be held in Tokyo, Japan, from May twenty-four to June first, nineteen hundred fifty-eight.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 20, 1958.
